void: THE BOX DATA IN THIS FILE IS VOID AS A TRANSFER MEASUREMENT. Ultralytics reads a numpy array as BGR; the harness passed the RGB array it had built for the overlays, so every figure was detected with red and blue exchanged. Re-running the same detect_wells call over the same 182 files reproduces these box totals exactly on the RGB side and gives 2-5x as many boxes on BGR, so the verdict derived here is withdrawn. STILL GOOD: papers, figures, hashes, pixel sizes, the 369 hand-counted regions, the exclusion list. NOT GOOD: every box, every box_verdict, every 'found' count, and every rate in 'summary'.
